scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @opsflow/api" "npm run dev -w @opsflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @opsflow/shared && npm run build -w @opsflow/api && npm run build -w @opsflow/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @opsflow/api && npm run lint -w @opsflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @opsflow/shared && npm run typecheck -w @opsflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @opsflow/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @opsflow/api && npm run test -w @opsflow/web
